newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S.Australia government sells building for A$68 mln.
newsitem.headline: S.Australia government sells building for A$68 mln.

text.p: Santos House, the tallest building in Adelaide which formerly belonged to the collapsed State Bank of South Australia, has been sold for A$68.2 million to Malaysian investment company Tan Pty Ltd.

The sale of the 32-storey building included the adjoining Plaza Building on King William St, the Stock Exchange Plaza on Currie Street, and the Delmont Building at the south-west corner of the site, state treasurer Stephen Baker said on Tuesday.
Baker said the sale price was above book value but well below the A$114 million spent to complete the building during the tenure of the former Labor administration.
"This is a symbolic sale ...(representing) one of the last major asset sales to be completed in the government's on-going clean up of the state's finances," Baker said in a statement.
